# Third-party components

- **cnc-ddraw** v7.1.0.0 - MIT License - https://github.com/FunkyFr3sh/cnc-ddraw (DirectDraw wrapper, shipped as `ddraw.dll`)
- **miniaudio** 0.11.x - public domain / MIT-0 - https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio (statically linked into `DSETUP.dll`)

Both are fetched by `tools/fetch_deps.ps1` and are not stored in this repository.
